To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
social entrepreneurship is an important field for future research.
the perceptions of individuals are influenced by their personal and sociological characteristics as well as the environmental factors in their context.
the factors explaining international entrepreneurial behavior are influenced by an individual’s perceptions toward social enterprise.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an international social entrepreneurship model that can explain the behavioral aspects of social enterprise venturing.
the factors that explain international social entrepreneurial potential and the development of a conceptual model that can explain international social entrepreneurial behavior.
the development of a conceptual model that will be used to understand the factors explaining social entrepreneurship and its internationalization in developing countries.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

international social entrepreneurship is a process of identifying a social problem, and then developing and implementing an entrepreneurial venture in order to provide a sustainable solution to the social problem.
international social entrepreneurial potential is a result of a complex set of variables.
the conceptual model developed in this study is a useful tool to understand the factors that influence international social entrepreneurship.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
international social entrepreneurship is a function of the individual's behavioral potential, which, in turn, is determined by the perceptions of feasibility, desirabilty, and propensity to act.

social entrepreneurship is an important area that needs further investigation and that the factors explaining international entrepreneurial behavior can be used to explain the internationalization of social entrepreneurship.
the factors that influence international social entrepreneurship can be grouped into three categories: (1) personal factors, (2) social factors, and (3) environmental factors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the international social entrepreneurial potential of an individual can be influenced by his/her perception of the social enterprise venture.
the concept of international social entrepreneurship is still evolving and that more research needs to be conducted in this area.
international social entrepreneurs are not necessarily different than other entrepreneurs.
